review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
